book.title: 1 PITA Pitato Pepa Bulupane Peyo Pee Leane Oko

content: Sosa Okona Piape Wandakali Tupa Yakamato Wua Piyapape Leane Oko

Wamba Kataisa bala tandaka neane oko nambato lee-mane andewane. Andipa nambato wandakali tupa lamawuato, Kataisa bala wua pua tandaka neane lo lamawua atalawane. Matili Goteto balana tii-pene oko mo pana ola-angi, balato tii-pene okone nambapi, yakamapi, Kitisene wandakali nanima nanima pitaka gulupeya. Tene okonena, namba sosa okona piape akali mindi atoto, sosa okona piape akali waka yakama mana langeyo-ko.

Wandakali waka tupamane pii taimane yakama languato, yakamato sosa okona piape oko piyapa lolai-kola, yakamato yole miaima lakae lo angu nembo toto, piape okone na-piyapape. Jia. Goteto yakamato piape okone pipiai lakae lo nembo teya nayuto, yakamato piape okone epelewa pua atoto, Gotena sipisipi yakamana kininga ateyai utupane kuai lo moyo ando atalapape.

Sosa okona piape akali yakama akali andane gene yene ateyama nembo toto, Gotena wandakali yakamato wua piyapape lo pii taimane na-lalapape. Jia. Gotena sipisipi tupamane balana asini epene okona peakale lo yakamato andawa lalapape.
Yakamato sipisipi yatawa atalane akali kawane okona piape kuai lo pua ateaindo, matili bala epola-angi, yakama yole epene wete koyo napiyane oko molopeyai. Yakamana yole okone yapowa yolopeya.
Yakama Gotena Pangosa Atalapape Leane Oko

Gotena pii pepa pelene eya mindimane loto, wandakali mindimane bala gene yene lipinga yale ateyo nembo teando, Goteto balana gene oko nayakale lalane tekeko, wandakali mindimane bala gene nayene napinga yale ateyo nembo teando, Goteto balana gene oko laiyu lalane layene eya. Tene okonena, iwana patane yame yakama pitaka gene nayene atoto, wandakali waka tupana pangosa atoto, sosana piape akali tupana pangosa atalapape. Akali utupanena pangosa atoto, Goteto yakama kuai lo atalapale nembo talane nayuto, yakamato kenda-pene awua atolai tupa balana kininga aimo lalapape. Aimo lalu, matili Goteto oto yata yane oko epola-angi, balato yakamana gene tupa laiyu leakale nembo toto, andipa yakama gene nayene atoto, Gotena kini tai-lene wete okona pangosa atalapape.
Yakamato Gote Lo Bilipi Leyo Loto, Satanena Pii Oko Tanga Lalapape Leane Oko

Pusi kapua andane wetete layone tupamane ŋili-ŋili taimane loto, wandakali andoko peyo noape lo aiya pua epoko piyaini. Utupane-mane wuane piyaini pua teke, yakamana yanda-pene akali Sataneto wandakali andoko minu mandeke puato, minu koyowape lo yuu okona epoko pua atalane. Tene okonena, Yakamato kuai lo nembo toto, Sataneto yakama minu makande pulane. Waiwa ando atalapape.

Sataneto yakama minu mandeke puato tandaka geya-kola, yakama tandaka no atalaini pua teke, yuu tupa pitakana Kitisene wandakali tupapi, tandaka no teke atalaini. Wuane tekeko, Gote bala nanima towa mini epene wete paluto, nanima ondo alane. Jisasa Kataisato yakama moyo piape peane okomane Goteto yakama bala towa atu balana yuu epene tii-pene okona atapowa atalapale lo ee lo mea okoni. Balanga tai-lene pitaka yapowa yalane. Andipa oto ukupini mindi angu yakamato tandaka no atolai-kola, matili balato yakama minu kuai lolo-peke loto, yakamana bilipi oko minu tai laya olopeya nembo talapape. Wuane nembo toto, yakamato Gote lo bilipi leyama nayu loto, Satanena pii oko tanga lo atalapape. Enene.

Sailasa bala nambana amene wete ateya nembo teyo okonena, balato pii ukupini utupa pepanga peleakale leyo. Enene wete, Goteto wandakali tupa ondowa moyalane. Goteto yakama ondowa moyo ateya-kola, yakamato bala minatawa atalapale loto, nambato yakama minu tai laya wato, yakamana pepa ukupini oko peyo epe leyo.

Goteto yakama balana wandakali atalapale lata yane pua teke, wamba balato Bapilone tane wandakali minditupa balana wandakali tupa ateakale lata ya-kola, utupane balana wandakali guleainipia. Andipa utupane-mane yakama kuai lo atalapa leyai. Dee, Maki bala nambana iwanane atoto, yakama kuai lo atalapa leya teke.
Yakamato Kitisene wandakali waka tupa towa epelewa yamapane yoto, sikane lalapape. Yakama pitaka Kataisa towa atu atoto, mini epene palu atalapape.
